AppearanceRow, FontSettingsGroup, FontSizeRow, FontFamilyRow, their CSS, and dictionaries are from DeepSeek Harness commit `39163dd30f703a79079e2d2446545cff3c453738`. Rendering and interaction are unchanged; runtime imports point to the same vendored primitives and extracted font contracts. `font-size-specs.ts` keeps the role specifications and the exact upstream family normalizer without loading the Host schema runtime.

The macOS adapter connects all three roles to native rendering, installed fonts, and the shared Host `ui-theme` namespace. Changes use Host revisions and schema validation; the installation preference file is a boot cache. Existing explicit desktop choices migrate once, with Host values taking precedence. The adapter lives in `ui/settings-theme.tsx`, `ui/src/web/settings_shell.rs`, and `ui/src/web/document_fonts.rs`. MIT terms: `../harness-primitives/LICENSE`.
